metadata.description: Everything TechTrip AI releases for Claude Code and other agent harnesses, in one catalog: small Claude Code tools hosted here, plus larger products (second brain, Obsidian knowledge companion) that live in their own repositories. Add the marketplace once and install what you need.

plugins.name: claude-session-finder
plugins.description: Find, search and resume past Claude Code sessions across every project on this machine: directory, session id, last active, the last thing you said, and the exact resume command. Includes a brain-dump tour.

plugins.name: techtrip-secondbrain
plugins.description: One-command bootstrapper for a generic LLM Wiki second brain on a fresh Mac: installs Obsidian and its community plugins, pulls the TechTrip-maintained claude-obsidian fork, scaffolds a clean vault, wires the Obsidian MCP server, ships the yt-fetch, x-fetch, voice-fetch, code-fetch and notebooklm-ingest source skills plus the new-idea origination scaffolder, and sets up git sync and backup. Harness-agnostic skills with Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot harness templates. Interactive and idempotent. Lives in its own repository; this entry tracks its releases.

plugins.name: claude-obsidian
plugins.description: TechTrip AI's maintained fork of AgriciDaniel's MIT-licensed claude-obsidian, a self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + Claude Code built on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. The fork is maintained independently and carries fixes and changes that are not merged upstream; the original author's credit and MIT license are retained. Installed automatically by techtrip-secondbrain; install from here to use it on its own.

author.name: AgriciDaniel (original); maintained by Terry Trippany, TechTrip AI
